paper.title: Ground state of the $S$=1/2 pyrochlore Heisenberg antiferromagnet: A quantum spin liquid emergent from dimensional reduction
paper.authors: Rico Pohle, Youhei Yamaji, Masatoshi Imada

results.system_description: Spin-1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet on the pyrochlore lattice, Eq. (1), H = J sum S_i · S_j with spin operators, J = 1; L = 2 cubic cluster with N_s = 128 sites, periodic boundaries; spin-parity even singlet sector.
results.variant: pair-product wave function with RBM correlator, spin-parity projection
results.source_location: Supplemental Material, Table SI, row mVMC-RBM, column psi+ (random)
results.eligibility_evidence: Supplemental Material, Table SI, column psi+ (random): E/N_s of the optimized pair-product wave function multiplied by a restricted Boltzmann machine correlator (mVMC-RBM), evaluated by VMC, with spin-parity projection. The text calls these strictly variational energies; the variance-extrapolated E_0 in the last row is not used.
results.notes: Energy per site in spin units, as printed. The second line of the table is the relative variance (<E^2> - <E>^2)/<E>^2 (Eq. S26), not Var(H), so no variance is recorded: sigma^2 = 0.000407(19). The error bar is from 20 to 40 statistically independent measurements; its exact meaning is not stated.

results.system_description: Spin-1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet on the pyrochlore lattice, Eq. (1), H = J sum S_i · S_j with spin operators, J = 1; L = 2 cubic cluster with N_s = 128 sites, periodic boundaries; spin-parity even singlet sector.
results.variant: pair-product wave function with RBM correlator, first Lanczos step, spin-parity projection
results.source_location: Supplemental Material, Table SI, row mVMC-RBM/Lanczos, column psi+ (random); main text, best variational energy
results.eligibility_evidence: Supplemental Material, Table SI, column psi+ (random): E/N_s of the optimized pair-product wave function multiplied by a restricted Boltzmann machine correlator (mVMC-RBM), improved by one Lanczos step (1 + alpha H) and evaluated by VMC, with spin-parity projection. The text calls these strictly variational energies; the variance-extrapolated E_0 in the last row is not used.
results.notes: Energy per site in spin units, as printed. The second line of the table is the relative variance (<E^2> - <E>^2)/<E>^2 (Eq. S26), not Var(H), so no variance is recorded: sigma^2 = 0.000169(12). The error bar is from 20 to 40 statistically independent measurements; its exact meaning is not stated. Varbench lists -252.007(21) for this cluster and method (-0.492201 per site in spin units), which is not printed in the paper; the paper's value is used.

issues: The mVMC and mVMC/Lanczos rows (pair-product without the RBM) are not neural-network states and are not entries. Tables SII and SIII (432 and 1024 sites) have no RBM rows.
